kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أعتكف (form VIII)
# أَعْتَكِفُ (ʔaʕtakifu) /ʔaʕ.ta.ki.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَكَفَ (iʕtakafa)
# أَعْتَكِفَ (ʔaʕtakifa) /ʔaʕ.ta.ki.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَكَفَ (iʕtakafa)
# أَعْتَكِفْ (ʔaʕtakif) /ʔaʕ.ta.kif/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِعْتَكَفَ (iʕtakafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
